title_zh: 甩柜 / Rolled · 空班 Blank sailing

why_attention.summary_zh: Blank sailing 近 90 天抽样 ≥45（2 页）；近 7 天 counts=24。甩柜/rolled 宽查询噪音极大，紧查询仍污染——热度以 blank sailing 为准。

definitions.def: Cargo booked but not loaded on the intended vessel (overbooking, docs, operational, weight, VGM late, etc.).
Often used similarly to rolled when cargo misses cutoff / not accepted for that sailing.
Carrier cancels a scheduled sailing or omits ports — capacity management or disruption.
Vessel skips a port in rotation — cargo may roll or transship.

who_pays.typical: Rebooking, storage, demurrage after roll often land on merchant depending on reason & contract; blank sailing is carrier schedule tool — liability case-by-case.

common_pitfalls: Assuming AIS 'vessel sailed' means YOUR container is aboard — verify container tracking.
Wide Chinese '甩货' search polluted by sports metaphors — use strict queries.
Ignoring demurrage clock after roll while box sits at origin terminal.

official_sources.note: Late/missing VGM is a common operational cause of not loading
Export demurrage free time vs vessel delay — related negotiation theme

country_hooks.note: Export roll narratives at SHA/NGB peaks
Import roll rare; blank sailing affects ETA
Feeder rolls to Priok common in industry talk — verify per booking

faq.q: 船开了柜一定在船上吗？
faq.a: 不一定。Rolled cargo 就是订了舱但未装上原定船。应用箱号跟踪核验，不要只看船名 AIS。
一般是船司运力管理/市场工具，不是「违法罚则」。影响是船期与舱位，可能连带费用钟。

faq.q: 被甩后会不会产生滞期？
faq.a: 柜若仍在起运港码头超过 free time，可能产生 export demurrage/堆存——取决于条款与责任归属。
